Name: Add queue depth alerting across entire worker fleet
Description: Implement alerting on queue depth for all worker queues, not just payments. Thresholds: warning at 1,000 jobs, page at 5,000 jobs. Apply the same thresholds consistently across the entire worker fleet. Owner: Kofi.

Name: Fix payment worker retry logic with exponential backoff and dead-letter queue
Description: Fix the retry logic in payment_worker.py, specifically the _process_with_retry function. Currently it retries 5 times back-to-back with no backoff or jitter, and on the fifth failure re-enqueues the job at the front of the main queue, causing retry storms. Changes required: (1) Implement exponential backoff with jitter between retries. (2) Cap the number of retries. (3) On final failure, send the job to a dead-letter queue at the back, not the front of the main queue. (4) Add tests that simulate processor 503 responses to cover the retry path. Owner: Marta.
